review_scope: Independent source-to-render visual comparison of all seven listed corrected renders. Not a precision dimensional or structural certification.
resolved_interim_issues: West five wide arches no longer fabricated full-height curtainwall: recessed rendered backing, discrete high windows and doors, visible central staircase now expressed.
Paired west stairs now have finite diagonal slab and open undersides instead of solid white triangular infill.
East central entrance now recessed with separate double-door division.
Previously visible coplanar side-wall material triangles absent in reviewed views.
supported_major_features: Six consecutive four-quadrant curved canopies, long-axis bay rhythm, front/back depth asymmetry.
Seating ascends toward east, with front west arcade and paired diagonal access stairs.
Rear low sloped-roof wings flank the taller central entry mass.
North end and south elevation preserve the lower rear-roof slope, seating rise and asymmetrical canopy projection.
Top view shows all six continuous canopy units with exposed rear-wing roofs and central entrance, rather than an invented roof covering the entire depth.
Canopy detail is intentionally a cropped detail view, not a complete-building framing image.
explicit_limits: 1981 historical original-design reconstruction; drawings are not certified as-built. Official virtual-campus record supports the 1981 event context, not precision conformity of every modeled component.

HP surfaces, raised hubs and transition heights are interpreted approximations; A6 +948 and A9 low-point relationship remains a scoped interpretation, not an independently verified surface equation. Printable shell thickness differs from original 6 cm RC shell.
2021 panorama has later lower-level infill/door changes, intentionally not copied into this historical design model. Not 2026 current condition.
Window/sash, rails, finish colours and historic plaque are simplified; plaque lettering is not asserted readable.
Authored plinth/site support is not surveyed terrain; hidden rooms and reinforcement omitted.
No trial print, no support-free-printing guarantee; water-tightness is a separate geometry QA, not established by visual review.
